q: Fossil fuels consist of coal, petroleum and ______.
e: Fossil fuels consist of coal, petroleum and natural gas. Fossil fuels are coal, petroleum, and natural gas, formed from ancient remains and finite. Hydrogen would fill a different blank than natural gas.

q: Coal is fossilised plant material containing mainly carbon together with hydrogen, nitrogen and ______.
e: Coal is fossilised plant material containing mainly carbon together with hydrogen, nitrogen and sulphur. Sulphur is the idea that completes this fact. Chlorine would fill a different blank than sulphur.

q: Crude oil and natural gas were formed from the remains of dead animals and plants that lived in the ______.
e: Crude oil and natural gas were formed from the remains of dead animals and plants that lived in the seas. Seas is the idea that completes this fact. Forests would fill a different blank than seas.
Natural gas consists mainly of methane, CH4. Methane, CH4 is the idea that completes this fact. Propane, C3H8 would fill a different blank than methane, CH4.

q: When coal is strongly heated in the absence of air, it produces a solid called ______.
e: When coal is strongly heated in the absence of air, it produces a solid called coke. Coke is the idea that completes this fact. Ash would fill a different blank than coke.

q: The main use of coke is as a ______ in the blast furnace for making iron.
e: The main use of coke is as a reducing agent in the blast furnace for making iron. Reducing agent is the idea that completes this fact. Oxidising agent would fill a different blank than reducing agent.

q: Crude oil is a mixture of many different ______ molecules.
e: Crude oil is a mixture of many different hydrocarbon molecules. A hydrocarbon contains only hydrogen and carbon. Carbohydrate would fill a different blank than hydrocarbon.

q: Non-renewable fuels are fuels which take millions of years to form and which are used up at a ______ rate.
e: Non-renewable fuels are fuels which take millions of years to form and which are used up at a rapid rate. Rapid is the idea that completes this fact. Slow would fill a different blank than rapid.

q: Renewable fuels are fuels produced from renewable resources such as ______.
e: Renewable fuels are fuels produced from renewable resources such as vegetable oils, animal oils, etc.. Vegetable oils, animal oils, etc. is the idea that completes this fact. Coal, oil, and gas would fill a different blank than vegetable oils, animal oils, etc.

q: Combustion of coal releases nitrogen oxides, sulphur dioxide, particulate matter (PM), mercury and dozens of other substances known to be hazardous to ______.
e: Combustion of coal releases nitrogen oxides, sulphur dioxide, particulate matter (PM), mercury and dozens of other substances known to be hazardous to human health. Human health is the idea that completes this fact. Soil fertility would fill a different blank than human health.

q: Myanmar has coal deposits in Shan State, Kachin State, Taninthayi Region and ______.
e: Myanmar has coal deposits in Shan State, Kachin State, Taninthayi Region and Sagaing Region. Sagaing Region is the idea that completes this fact. Bago Region would fill a different blank than Sagaing Region.

q: British Burma exported its first barrel of crude oil in ______.
e: British Burma exported its first barrel of crude oil in 1853. 1853 is the idea that completes this fact. 1887 would fill a different blank than 1853.

q: The London-based Burma Oil Company (BOC) began production in the Yenangyaung oil field in ______.
e: The London-based Burma Oil Company (BOC) began production in the Yenangyaung oil field in 1887. 1887 is the idea that completes this fact. 1853 would fill a different blank than 1887.

q: Most coal was formed during the ______ period (286–360 million years ago).
e: Most coal was formed during the Carboniferous period (286–360 million years ago). Carboniferous is the idea that completes this fact. Permian would fill a different blank than Carboniferous.

q: Coal contains between ______ carbon by mass.
e: Coal contains between 80 to 90% carbon by mass. 80 to 90% is the idea that completes this fact. 40 to 50% would fill a different blank than 80 to 90%.
